notes.title: Doomwalker v0.4.0 update notes
notes.notes:
[h3][b][u]Price Increase[/u][/b][/h3][p][i]$10 USD ----> $15 USD[/i][/p][p][/p][p]This price increase reflects that amount of content added and improvements made to the game since the initial early access release in October 2024. The price will increase once more to the final release price of [b]$20 USD[/b] when the game transitions from early access to normal release (TBA). [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b][u]New Level Cap[/u][/b][/h3][p]30 ---> [b]40[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]New Player Abilities (level 40)[/u][/b][/h3][p][b]Inferno (Fire)[/b] - Engulf everything nearby in a storm of flame, dealing massive damage over 6 seconds.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Void Tear (Shadow)[/b] - Rend the fabric of reality, causing a tear that seeks nearby enemies and deals damage to anything nearby every 0.25s for 5s.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Demon's Blood (Chaos)[/b] - Dash rapidly between nearby enemies, damaging them and triggering void instability each time a new target is hit.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]New Companion Abilities (level 30)[/u][/b][/h3][p][b]Corrupt Essence (Dog)[/b] - Infuse an enemy with void energy, leeching health from the target and other nearby enemies to the player over 2s.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bloodlust (Cat)[/b] - Rage and chaos consume your cat, causing it to furiously swipe nearby enemies dealing heavy damage over 2s.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bgawwwk (Chicken)[/b] - Your chicken unleashes a primal bgawk, summoning an army of chicks that last 10s and seek out nearby foes and damage them.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]New Zones[/u][/b][/h3][p][b]Kizuni Fen[/b]  (20-40) - A mist-shrouded swamp holding ancient secrets, and dangers, within...[/p][p][b]Blackstone Pass[/b] (25-40) - A perilous mountain pass blackened by dragonsfire. Tread carefully...[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]New Enemies/Mobs and Bosses[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Griffon[/p][/*][*][p]Spiders[/p][/*][*][p]Plants[/p][/*][*][p]Ents[/p][/*][*][p]Rats[/p][/*][*][p]Liches[/p][/*][*][p]Dragons[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b][u]Total Quests[/u][/b][/h3][p]70 ----->  [b]98[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]
[b][u]Total Equippable Items[/u][/b][/h3][p]34 -----> [b]45[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Doomwalker v0.3.3 and v0.3.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p][b][i][u]Please allow longer initial load times (1-2 minutes) when entering the main world! [/u][/i][/b][/p][p][u][i][b](for better performance in game)[/b][/i][/u][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][u][b]v0.3.3 Patch Notes[/b][/u][/h3][p]This is a relatively small patch that updates the game engine from Unreal Engine 5.4 to 5.6 - offering more optimized loading/streaming processes, less stuttering than previous versions of Doomwalker, and a higher more consistent framerate while playing.[/p][p][/p][p]Swapping hotbar slots now works as intended (no longer makes one of your abilities vanish).[/p][p][/p][p]Added combat info section to the companion tab of the character page (default 'C' key).[/p][p][/p][p]New mobs:[/p][p]Horses and Dragons![/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b][u]v0.3.4 Patch Notes[/u][/b][/h3][p]This is effectively a pre-patch for 0.4.0, bringing stability and performance inprovements and updates to the world and zones being worked on for next patch: Blackstone Pass and Kizuni Fen.[/p][p][/p][p]You can finally unlock the area atop the spire in Deathfall Ruins... unlocking more of your full potential as the Doomwalker and providing more background to the history of world and the forces at work within...[/p][p][/p][p]More grass types in the world including snow and wheat![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]New mobs:[/p][p]Griffons[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b][u]v0.4.0 will be releasing soon - notes to come[/u] [/b][/h3][p]I am trying to rush and get it out during the Summer Sale for you guys![/p][p][/p][p][b]This will be a major content update with two brand new zones, tons of new quests, stories, loot and equipment, things to slay in glorious combat, and new developments to the main story![/b][/p]

notes.title: Doomwalker v0.3.1 and 0.3.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[u][b][h3]v0.3.1 Notes[/h3][/b][/u]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] The Howling Dens zone has been improved.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you could use abilities while asleep, bugging out the player.
[*] Fixed critical issues with the player save/load process.
[*] Adjusted the collision on a few models for better gameplay.
[*] The pause menu no longer permanently blocks mouse click visibility after closing the menu.
[/list]



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[u][b][h3]v0.3.2 Notes[/h3][/b][/u]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] The Yorikuzo Heights and Moonless Woodlands Zones have been improved upon.
[*] The Character equipment page now has a new tab for your companion where you can select companion type, color, and see information (work in progress).
[*] Added Motion Blur toggle in the settings menu.
[*] Added Window mode option in the settings menu.
[*] Added more fast travel locations to the overworld.
[*] Elevators now have buttons to call it to your level (finally)!
[*] Fixed the collision of many meshes so that the player companion no longer passes through into the void.
[*] Exiting the Pause menu should now always resume the game.
[*] Reduced the performance impact of many light sources and overall overlap in the world.
[/list]

notes.title: Doomwalker Early Access v0.2.0 and v0.2.1 update notes
notes.notes:
[u]Due to massive changes in gameplay, world design, and user experience, [b]it is highly recommended that you delete your save file and start a new game if you have already downloaded and played the game prior to the release of v0.2.0[/b].[/u]



[b][u][h3]General[/h3][/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Level Cap: [b]30[/b]
[*] The world now has cliffs and more diverse foliage!
[*] Enemy AI has been improved.
[*] General in-game performance has been massively improved.
[*] Many abilities that enemies can cast have been reworked.
[*] Unlocking a new fast travel location now has an updated visual.
[*] Added an adjustable FOV slider to the settings menu.
[*] Added an "Unstuck" button to the help menu.
[*] Added new tabs to the Help menu: [b]Equipment, Currency, Talents[/b]
[*] Most of the player UI has been completely redesigned and updated for visual clarity (still WIP).
[*] Fixed an issue where the wrong quests were unlocking after turning in a quest.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused certain bosses to be treated as normal enemies.
[*] All in-game music has been upgraded, enjoy.
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes the player questlog and hotbar would not save/load properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the audio was not changing correctly upon entering or leaving dungeons.
[/list]

[b][u][h3]Improved Tutorial Experience[/h3][/u][/b]
[list]
[*] The new game tutorial experience is now more in-depth, and introduces the player to boss combat and the in-game menus.
[/list]

[b][u][h3]Ability Reworks[/h3][/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Kiriotoshi [/b]
OLD: 3x damage to a single target.
NEW: 2x and cause shadow energy to explode for 1x damage to all nearby enemies after 1 second.
[/list]

[b][u][h3]New Zones[/h3][/u][/b]
[list] 
[*] Forgotten Grove (Tutorial)
[*] Decimus Arena has been redesigned.
[/list]

[b][u][h3]Gatherables[/h3][/u][/b]
[list]
[*] There are now gatherable items to collect in the world!
[*] Be on the lookout for items on the ground, they might lead you to powerful treasure...
[/list]

[b][u][h3]Quests[/h3][/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Tons of new quests have been added to the world! (46 --> [b]67[/b])
[*] Most existing questlines have been expanded upon or have been reworked.
[/list]

notes.title: Doomwaler Early Access v0.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[u][b][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed some audio events that were incorrectly triggering on/off, or would cut off halfway through.
[*] Some enemy spawners were not working (not spawning enemies), they should now be fixed.
[*] Adjusted the location of the questgiver icon for certain characters.
[*] Fixed an issue where the UI was not refreshing upon selecting and removing talent points.
[*] Fixed an issue where the quest log was visible even when you had no quests.
[*] Ambient music now fades out while in boss combat instead of playing alongside boss music.
[*] The drawing order of the player UI has been reorganized to fix issues where panels were not allowing anything drawn beneath to be interacted with (hovered/clicked).
[/list]


[u][b][h3]General[/h3][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Adjusted player level-up experience scaling.
[*] More quests now have a loot reward!
[*] Slightly lowered the player character mesh position.
[*] Slightly increased character sprint speed and slightly reduced run speed.
[*] Reduced the time delay before respawning by 50%.
[*] Fixed an issue where the quest log was visible even when you had no quests.
[*] Signposts finally give information about where things are in the world!
[*] Leveling up now knockbacks nearby foes and has an updated visual!
[*] Improved tooltips!
[*] Improved fast travel menu!
[/list]

[u][b][h3]Steam Achievements[/h3][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] You can now pursue 5 achievements that have been added to the game (with many more to come)!
[/list]

notes.title: Doomwalker v0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[u][b][h3]Bug Fixes  [/h3][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where boss music was not fading out upon respawn, causing an infinite loop of glorious melody.
[/list]


[u][b][h3]General[/h3][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Enemy Info bars are now visible from further away to give players more time to see them before entering combat.
[*] Friendly characters now have more diverse dialogue options.
[*] Quick Heal no longer goes on cooldown if used at max health.
[*] A mysterious fog has appeared in the Whispering Depths dungeon...
[*] In addition to pressing W, you can now move the player forward by holding down both mouse buttons at the same time.
[/list]


[u][b][h3]Settings Page Improvements[/h3][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added a Vsync toggle option.
[*] Added game setting options for textures.
[*] Added an option to toggle in-game speech bubbles.
[*] The 'Quit' button now takes you back to the main menu instead of exiting the game.
[/list]


[u][b][h3]Help Page Improvements[/h3][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added a Controls tab where players can view the game controls.
[*] Added a Questing tab.
[*] Added a Dungeons tab.
[*] Added a Rituals tab.
[/list]

notes.title: Doomwalker v0.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2][u][b]Doomwalker Early Access v0.1.1 Patch Notes[/b][/u][/h2]

[h3][b]Shadows[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Directional lights in the overworld should now produce smoother shadows.
[*] Shadows should now flicker less often when viewed from a long distance.
[*] Some foliage lightmaps have been altered to increase shadow resolution.
[*] Shadows are now darker.
[/list]


[h3][b]Lights[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some lights and niagara effects did not cull at large distances from the player, resulting in performance losses.
[*] Increased fog density in the overworld.
[*] Sky Lighting now works differently in the overworld.
[/list]


[h3][b]World Objects[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the collision on some world items that caused them to fall through the floor and be lost to the ether.
[/list]


[h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed several audio cues which were not scaling properly with the volume sliders.
[/list]


[h3][b]Main Menu[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added game version to bottom-right screen.
[/list]


[h3][b]Enemy Adjustments[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Bandit Brawler - Health increased by 10%, Damage decreased by 10%
[*] Bandit Strategist - Damage decreased by 10%
[*] Bandit Taskmaster - Health increased by 10%
[*] Kizuni Watcher - Health increase by 15%
[*] Chattering Ghoul - Health increased by 20%
[*] Lost Soul - Health increased by 10%, Damage Increased by 5%
[*] Pustulent Horror - Health Increased by 10%
[/list]


[i]As always, if you encounter bugs, performance issues, or have quality-of-life ideas, please post them in the Steam discussion section![/i]

notes.title: Doomwalker Early Access Release
notes.notes:
[h2][u][b]Version 0.1 Release Notes[/b][/u][/h2]
Delve into the world of Lyra and explore the land, aid those you come across, and uncover a plot to summon an ancient darkness rising once again... Fight, explore, discover new abilities and powerful upgrades. Only one can stand against the tide, will you rise, or will you be washed away?

30

Decimus Arena (18-30)

Challenge
